newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WIG seen at 18,131 at end-June - poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish WIG seen at 18,131 at end-June - poll.

text.p: Polish brokers expect the Warsaw bourse's main WIG index to end the first half of the year at 18,131 points, the financial daily Nowa Europa said on Monday.
The brokers expected the main market, currently at 17,457.9 points, to end the year at 18,544 points.
Predictions for the end of the first half of June ranged between 13,200 and 23,000 points, the paper said.
